title: Refuse a runtime that lacks an open flag the same way safeOpenFlags does (checkout.ts and backup-file.ts; #306 round 1)
description: adoptToolFile now refuses, through safeOpenFlags in src/adapters/tpm2-tools.ts, when O_NOFOLLOW, O_NONBLOCK or O_NOCTTY is not a number, because an undefined flag is dropped silently by the bitwise or (a symlink followed, a FIFO blocking). The same OR'd flags appear in src/adapters/checkout.ts (about lines 97-99) and src/adapters/backup-file.ts (about lines 131-133). Apply the same refusal there, or share one helper, with a test that a runtime lacking each flag is refused. Out of scope for #306, found by its review.

acceptanceCriteria.text: checkout.ts and backup-file.ts refuse to open a file when a flag they rely on is undefined, each with a test that removes the flag from a stand-in constants object
